## Who I am

I worked on AI infrastructure at Amazon for ~2 years, most recently on **AWS
SageMaker HyperPod** — the managed service for large-scale model training and
inference. My work there centered on cluster resiliency features such as deep health checks
and continuous health monitoring systems for the Kubernetes and Slurm offerings as well as 
bespoke features like tiered checkpointing. 

I'm now in the UBC Master of Data Science program (2026 cohort).

## What this site is

A public notebook. I write up things I'm working through in machine learning —
mostly LLMs, inference, and the infra systems that power them. Posts are mostly about what 
I don't yet understand yet and cool stuff I'm reading about.

## What I'm into right now

- **AI Infrastructure** - large scale orchestration, resiliency, fault tolerance
- **LLM inference internals** - tokenization, the KV cache, batching, inference at scale

## Beyond this

I also love chess and videogames so you might see a few posts on those topics as well!
